svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 11.9 s, bun check 36.2 s, tsgo 79.2 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.4 GiB, tsgo 52.8 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.18 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.37 s, 1.51 GiB; tsgo 10.80 s, 7.49 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.17 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.33 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.87 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.50 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.33 s, 1.15 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.02 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.34 s, 5.34 GiB; tsgo 12.03 s, 7.44 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.06 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.10 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.28 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.09 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.19 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.52 s, 0.23 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 0.96 s, 1.15 GiB; bun check 2.95 s, 0.93 GiB; tsgo 5.51 s, 4.32 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.13 s, 1.44 GiB; bun check 2.41 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 6.85 s, 5.79 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.18 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.46 s, 0.88 GiB; tsgo 6.73 s, 4.42 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.54 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.56 s, 1.03 GiB; tsgo 13.55 s, 6.16 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.58 s, 1.38 GiB; bun check 5.01 s, 0.76 GiB; tsgo 10.34 s, 6.39 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.42 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.91 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 2.89 s, 1.78 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.61 s, 0.42 GiB; tsgo 1.52 s, 1.30 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.52 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 1.66 s, 1.43 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.25 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.70 s, 0.41 GiB; tsgo 1.34 s, 1.12 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.22 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.44 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.16 s, 1.08 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.78 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.82 s, 1.74 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 10:12 UTC; tsrs commit 614a23fe3c188393053182f244b1a0b29e7297da. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
